headline: Maui County Cultural Resources Commission

meeting.summary: The commission put off a decision on Imua Family Services' preschool plan and approved plans for two homes rebuilt after the 2023 fire.
meeting.recap: A representative of the County Council chair asked the commission to delay a decision.[[0:33:40]] Imua's planner listed three special uses: a preschool, parking on an old tennis court, and a trellis.[[0:59:26]] Staff said the commission must decide within 90 days, or the plan is approved automatically.[[1:29:10]] Imua agreed to waive the 90-day limit and bring more information before January's meeting.[[2:01:55]] The commission approved plans for an accessory dwelling unit (a small second home) at 173 Shaw Street.[[2:30:36]] The commission voted to approve her home plans.[[2:55:59]] The commission voted to keep the front yard as is and study parking on side streets.[[3:27:49]] The commission agreed to move its next meeting from January 2 to January 9.[[3:28:41]]
decided: The commission accepted the proposed plans for the accessory dwelling unit at 173 Shaw Street.
The commission voted to approve the plans for the Front Street home.
The commission agreed to hold its next meeting on January 9 instead of January 2.
meeting.next: Imua's planner said the team is trying to set up another community meeting this month. Imua is to come back to the commission with a community outreach plan.
